summary: Proposes a new Telnet option for X.3 PAD, a way to control packet assembly and disassembly behavior for terminals on X.25-style networks. It asked for discussion and suggestions. It is now historic.

eli5.summary: Some old terminals reach computers through a box that packs their typing into packets. This option lets Telnet control how that box behaves.

questions: what is the telnet x.3 pad option
how does telnet control a pad
